treasures.name: fallen leaf
treasures.desc: A red-and-yellow leaf as big as a blanket. It crackles when you touch it.

treasures.name: twig
treasures.desc: A thin, crooked twig that snapped off the hedge. Just your size for a walking stick, or for poking things.

favours.ask: find me a sturdy twig from near the hedge so we can use it to knock down the berries

diary.text: I found a shiny silver hoop and thought it was a treasure! And then I looked at frogspawn and saw tiny movements inside the eggs. The pond was COLD and foggy, and I couldn’t find a twig. Why won’t the phone tell me where the cat is? I’m sleepy and my toes are numb. My teapot feels like home, but I wish I had a blanket.
